title: Paper workspace without tabs: the reader owns the PDF, paper details move behind an ⓘ sheet
acceptance_criteria: Given a paper workspace on desktop, when it opens, then there are no PDF/Details tabs. The left panel shows the PDF, or, without one, the PDF states (retrieval progress, OpenAlex DOI fallback, upload, processing steps, failure with retry), with the abstract below.

Given the workspace header, when the user activates the ⓘ 'Paper details' button (mouse, keyboard or touch), then a sheet opens with the title, citation, authors, actions (Edit details, Look up again, links), abstract, identifiers with copy, 'Where this information came from', an Advanced disclosure containing the search index status and Rebuild, and Delete paper. It closes with Esc, the close button or an outside click, and returns focus to the ⓘ button.
Given a paper with a PDF, when the user opens the reader's PDF menu, then it shows file name, pages, size and source, and offers Open original, Download, Replace PDF… and Remove PDF….

Given Remove PDF…, when the user confirms in the AlertDialog (which states what happens to the reader, summaries and earlier answers), then the PDF is detached and deleted with durable storage cleanup (ARA-095's job). The reader returns to the upload state, earlier answers keep their quoted passages, and chats pinned to that PDF stay readable.
Given Replace PDF…, when a new PDF is uploaded, then it becomes the active PDF with today's semantics: earlier answers keep citing the PDF they used.
Given mobile (390px), when the workspace opens, then the segments are Chat | PDF, ⓘ opens the details as a bottom sheet, and no chat content overflows horizontally.
Given a chat scrolled under the sticky paper-chip row, when it is stuck, then the row has an opaque background and a hairline, and no text shows through.
Given DESIGN.md and PRODUCT.md, when the change lands, then their workspace descriptions (tabs, Details) match the new layout.
test_cases: Component: no tabs; reader states; ⓘ sheet sections, focus return and Esc; the PDF menu header and items; Remove PDF confirmation copy and state change; Replace flow.
Backend: remove the active PDF, with document deletion, storage cleanup, chats' pinned PDF handling, and summaries and citation snapshots kept readable.
Responsive: 390px with no horizontal overflow; Chat | PDF segments; bottom sheet.
Visual check in light and dark on the user's test copy, run by the lead.
verification: Planned on 2026-10-10; starts after ARA-095 merges, because it reuses paper deletion, metadata editing and storage cleanup. Branch feat/ara-097-workspace-redesign.
